messages.subject: Saxena - payment processing and tax treatment
messages.plaintextBody:
James, just to confirm before payroll runs the figures: PILON £71,000 through PAYE; ex gratia £130,000 with the first £30,000 tax-free and the balance taxed; £750+VAT fees direct to Drummond Hale; outplacement direct to the provider. Total cost to us comes out around £232,000 including employer's NIC. Does that match your record?

Grace

messages.plaintextBody:
Grace - yes, that all matches. The £30,000 tax-free element is under ss.401-403 ITEPA; balance of the ex gratia is taxable. Fee contribution invoice should be addressed to Dr Saxena but marked payable by Halstead. All correct on our side.
